newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE stock trade loses steam as Ramadan-end nears.
newsitem.headline: UAE stock trade loses steam as Ramadan-end nears.

text.p: Trade on the unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market lost steam in the week to Thursday as the country slowed down near the end of the Islamic month of Ramadan.
Turnover was limited with only six shares rising, edging the National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index up 5.5 points to 2,522.88 from 2,517.37, dealers said.
Trade in market leader telecommunications firm Etisalat was suspended in the week ahead of its payment of a 25 dirham cash dividend to shareholders for the second half of 1996.
NBAD shares remained at 455. Al-Dhafra Insurance and Al-Ain al-Ahlia shares were steady at 885 and 1,250 respectively.
Abu Dhabi National Hotels Co shares ended the week at 1,035.
